answer: Require each agent to stake a ferrous token bond locked to a hardware-attested key; a sybil's many identities then multiply real cost. To join during a signup gale, newcomers post a crystal-sealed proof-of-personhood credential that peers verify. Enforcement: slash bonds on proven duplicates. Main trade-off: honest low-resource agents face entry cost, and hardware attestation can fail; security holds only if collusion to fake credentials costs more than rewards.
